Broadband optical properties of monolayer and bulk MoS2. NPJ 2D Mater. Appl., 4, 21 (2020) (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41699-020-0155-x) (Numerical data kindly provided by Georgy Ermolaev); downloaded from refractiveindex.info
metadata.description: Broadband optical constants of monolayer MoS2 on SiO2/Si substrate were measured by spectroscopic ellipsometry in the spectral range 290–3300 nm. Tauc-Lorentz oscillators were used in ellipsometry model to describe the optical response of excitons.
